$comment: Single source of truth for the repository-creation issue template's dropdown options and the org-level variables copied into newly created/forked repos. Read at runtime by handle-repository-creation-request.yml (the 'Validate Issue Input' step, via the GitHub Contents API) so those lists are not hardcoded in the workflow script. NOTE: the issue template (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/repository_creation_request.yml) still hardcodes its own dropdown option lists too, since GitHub issue forms are static YAML and cannot read this file at render time - keep the two in sync by hand whenever either changes.
